WHEELOFLOOT.Setting.SpinSecondsHint: How long the wheel takes to settle. The GM's setting governs every client, so the spin stays in sync.
WHEELOFLOOT.Setting.DefaultSlotsHint: How many slices a brand new wheel starts with. Any existing wheel keeps the size it was built at.
WHEELOFLOOT.Setting.TickSoundHint: Play the ticking track while the wheel spins. Affects only this client.
WHEELOFLOOT.Use.Charges: Several charges, but does not recharge
WHEELOFLOOT.Fault.NoRanges: No result has a slot range. Open the table and press the crosshair icon to normalise it.
WHEELOFLOOT.Fault.Gaps: {count} slot(s) have no result (first: {first}). Normalise the table.
WHEELOFLOOT.Fault.FormulaHigh: The formula rolls 1-{faces} but results only cover 1-{slots}. Normalise the table.
WHEELOFLOOT.Fault.FormulaLow: The formula only rolls 1-{faces}, so slots {from}-{slots} can never come up.
WHEELOFLOOT.Launcher.Title: Wheel of Loot
WHEELOFLOOT.Launcher.SpinsHint: The wheel opens for everyone, but only players with a spin can turn it. Each spin is spent the moment it is used, so nobody can spam it.
WHEELOFLOOT.Launcher.Notes: A player with no character assigned cannot be given loot, so their spin will be refused. A ⚠ on a table means its slots have gaps or overlaps — fix it in the builder first.
WHEELOFLOOT.Launcher.NoTablesYet: There are no rollable tables in this world yet. Make a wheel now?
WHEELOFLOOT.Wheel.Watching: You are watching. The GM decides who spins.
WHEELOFLOOT.Wheel.GiftHint: This puts {item} into someone else's inventory instead of your own. You keep nothing.
WHEELOFLOOT.Wheel.RefuseWarning: You will not get another spin, and you walk away with nothing.
WHEELOFLOOT.Builder.Title: Wheel Builder
WHEELOFLOOT.Builder.RefreshHint: Re-read every compendium and the world's items. Use after adding, removing or editing items in game.
WHEELOFLOOT.Builder.HideUsed: Hide items already on the wheel
WHEELOFLOOT.Builder.SingleUseHint: Some systems file charged magic items as consumables too. This hides anything with several charges or that recharges on a rest.
WHEELOFLOOT.Builder.Variants: {n} entries share this name, from different books. Expand to compare.
WHEELOFLOOT.Builder.LikelyDuplicate: Another entry shares this name, source, rarity and price — probably a true duplicate.
WHEELOFLOOT.Builder.RerollHint: Swap this prize for a random one from the filtered list, keeping its slots
WHEELOFLOOT.Builder.DropHint: Drag items here from the left, or from any compendium window.
WHEELOFLOOT.Builder.EmptyWheel: Nothing on the wheel yet. Drag something in, or roll a wheel.
WHEELOFLOOT.Builder.PadHint: Absorb the difference into the wedge that already has the most slots.
WHEELOFLOOT.Builder.MissingItem: This item no longer exists in the world. Replace or remove it.
WHEELOFLOOT.Builder.NameClash: Another wedge has this same name.
WHEELOFLOOT.Builder.CouldNotLoad: That item could not be loaded — it may have been deleted.
WHEELOFLOOT.Builder.WarnRecharge: This recharges on a rest — it is a permanent item, not a single-use one.
WHEELOFLOOT.Builder.WarnCharges: This has several charges. It is expendable, but not a single use.
WHEELOFLOOT.Builder.RollWheelHint: Replace everything on the wheel with a random draw from the filtered list.
WHEELOFLOOT.Builder.RollWheelBody: Draws from the {pool} item(s) your filters currently show, and fills all {slots} slots. Everything on the wheel now is replaced.
WHEELOFLOOT.Builder.FillHint: Top the wheel up to its size with random prizes, leaving what is already there alone.
WHEELOFLOOT.Builder.FillBody: There are {slots} slot(s) to fill, drawn from the {pool} item(s) your filters currently show. Nothing already on the wheel is touched.
WHEELOFLOOT.Builder.WeightByRarityHint: Commoner prizes take more of the wheel than rare ones, so a legendary stays a thrill rather than a coin flip.
WHEELOFLOOT.Builder.ClearBody: Remove all {n} wedge(s)? Nothing is written to the table until you save.
WHEELOFLOOT.Builder.UnbalancedNote: It will still work — it simply becomes a {total}-slot wheel — but the odds will not be the ones you planned.
WHEELOFLOOT.Builder.NewHint: Creates an empty RollTable and opens the builder on it.
WHEELOFLOOT.Card.Speaker: The Wheel
WHEELOFLOOT.Migrate.Title: Wheel of Loot has been renamed
WHEELOFLOOT.Migrate.Body: This module used to be called sbts-loot-wheel. There is data in this world under the old name:
WHEELOFLOOT.Migrate.Ledger: {n} outstanding spin(s) in the old ledger
WHEELOFLOOT.Migrate.Items: {n} item(s) stamped as won from a wheel
WHEELOFLOOT.Migrate.Safety: Bringing it across only adds to those documents — nothing is deleted, renamed or overwritten, and you can safely say no and decide later.
WHEELOFLOOT.Migrate.Skipped: Wheel of Loot: left the old data alone. You will be asked again next session.
WHEELOFLOOT.Migrate.Done: Wheel of Loot: brought across {spins} spin(s) and re-stamped {items} item(s).
WHEELOFLOOT.Migrate.Failed: Wheel of Loot: the migration did not finish. Nothing was lost — see the console, and it will be offered again next session.
WHEELOFLOOT.Notify.GMOnly: Only the GM can present a wheel.
WHEELOFLOOT.Notify.NoGM: Wheel of Loot: no GM is connected, so the wheel cannot be used.
WHEELOFLOOT.Notify.NoSocketlib: Wheel of Loot needs socketlib, which is not active. The wheel is disabled.
WHEELOFLOOT.Notify.NoTables: There are no rollable tables in this world yet.
WHEELOFLOOT.Notify.NoPlayers: There are no player users in this world.
WHEELOFLOOT.Notify.TableNotFound: Wheel of Loot: that rollable table could not be found.
WHEELOFLOOT.Notify.TableNotReady: Wheel of Loot: "{name}" is not ready. {fault}
WHEELOFLOOT.Notify.EntriesMissing: Wheel of Loot: {n} wheel entries no longer exist in this world ({names}). Fix them in the builder first.
WHEELOFLOOT.Notify.WheelClosed: That wheel is no longer open. Ask your GM to present it again.
WHEELOFLOOT.Notify.NoSpins: You have no spins left on this wheel.
WHEELOFLOOT.Notify.NoCharacter: You have no assigned character, so there is nowhere to put the loot.
WHEELOFLOOT.Notify.NowhereToPutIt: There is no character to give this to — use Gift to hand it to someone.
WHEELOFLOOT.Notify.BadGiftTarget: That character cannot receive the gift.
WHEELOFLOOT.Notify.NobodyToGift: There is nobody else with a character to gift this to.
WHEELOFLOOT.Notify.GrantFailed: Wheel of Loot: could not give {item} to {actor}. Gave nothing.
WHEELOFLOOT.Notify.SpinFailed: The wheel could not be spun. Ask your GM to check the console.
WHEELOFLOOT.Notify.ResolveFailed: Could not finish the wheel. Ask your GM to check the console.
WHEELOFLOOT.Notify.AlreadyOnWheel: That item is already on the wheel.
WHEELOFLOOT.Notify.ItemsOnly: Only Items can go on the wheel.
WHEELOFLOOT.Notify.TwinOnWheel: "{name}" is already on the wheel from a different source. Both are now listed.
WHEELOFLOOT.Notify.Recharges: "{name}" recharges on a rest — it is not a single-use item.
WHEELOFLOOT.Notify.NothingToPad: There is nothing on the wheel to pad.
WHEELOFLOOT.Notify.CannotAbsorb: Cannot absorb {n} slots into "{name}" — remove a wedge instead.
WHEELOFLOOT.Notify.PoolEmpty: Nothing to draw from — widen the filters on the left.
WHEELOFLOOT.Notify.WheelRolled: Rolled a wheel of {wedges} prize(s) across {slots} slots.
WHEELOFLOOT.Notify.NoRoom: The wheel is already full at {n} slots.
WHEELOFLOOT.Notify.Reindexed: Re-indexed {n} items. Every wheel entry still resolves.
WHEELOFLOOT.Notify.RefreshFailed: Could not refresh the item list. See the console.
WHEELOFLOOT.Notify.NothingToSave: The wheel is empty — add at least one prize before saving.
WHEELOFLOOT.Notify.SaveFailed: Could not save the table. See the console.
WHEELOFLOOT.Notify.CreateFailed: Could not create the table. See the console.
